achievements.name: Prologue cleared
achievements.detail: Finish the opening Remembrance chapter for one of the thirteen pilots.

achievements.name: One route finished
achievements.detail: Play one pilot's Remembrance scenes through to the end of that character's story.

achievements.name: All stories cleared
achievements.detail: Finish the Remembrance story of every one of the thirteen pilots.

achievements.name: First area held
achievements.detail: Win every Destruction battle in the first defense area.

achievements.name: Outer areas held
achievements.detail: Clear the Destruction battles in the defense areas after the first.

achievements.name: S rank
achievements.detail: Earn an S rank on a Destruction battle.

achievements.name: Wide strike
achievements.detail: Destroy a dense cluster of enemies with a single Sentinel attack.

achievements.name: All objectives
achievements.detail: Complete every optional objective across the Destruction battles.

achievements.name: Full armory
achievements.detail: Unlock every armament and raise each terminal function as far as it will go.

achievements.name: Mystery files
achievements.detail: Unlock a set of Mystery Files in the archive.

achievements.name: Full archive
achievements.detail: Unlock every Mystery File so nothing in the archive stays locked.

achievements.name: Every snack
achievements.detail: Eat each food that can be bought on the walks home.

achievements.name: Final record
achievements.detail: Reach the last story sequence after the pilots' routes are finished.
